shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace/app /workspace/__agent_eval__ && cat /workspace/next.config.ts /workspace/tsconfig.json && for f in /workspace/app/*; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20 && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

(npm start -- -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ && break; sleep 1; done; echo "--- no cookie, no accept-language ---"; curl -s -H 'Accept-Language;' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'data-testid="[a-z]*">[^<]*'; echo "--- theme=dark, fr-CH,fr;q=0.9,en;q=0.8 ---"; curl -s -b 'theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: fr-CH,fr;q=0.9,en;q=0.8' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'data-testid="[a-z]*">[^<]*'; echo "--- no theme cookie, other cookies present, en-US ---"; curl -s -b 'session=abc; foo=bar' -H 'Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'data-testid="[a-z]*">[^<]*'; echo "--- q-reordered: en;q=0.3,de;q=0.9 ---"; curl -s -b 'theme=solarized' -H 'Accept-Language: en;q=0.3,de;q=0.9' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'data-testid="[a-z]*">[^<]*'; echo "--- wildcard only ---"; curl -s -H 'Accept-Language: *' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'data-testid="[a-z]*">[^<]*'; echo "--- empty theme cookie ---"; curl -s -b 'theme=' -H 'Accept-Language: ja' http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'data-testid="[a-z]*">[^<]*'
